content:
**Route 83A** is a roadway in *Fallout 76*.

The roadway is located in Appalachia.

Two separate segments run both north and south of Highway 62. The northern section serves as the southern border of The Whitespring Grounds, also known as Golf Road. The southern loop runs from Route 93 in the east, past Big Bend Tunnel West and Lake Reynolds, then merging with Route 83.

Route 83A appears in *Fallout 76*.
